title: 在源仓库先捕获低层证据，再由中央知识层分类
summary: 跨仓库 Intake 不应只上传‘CI failed’。源仓库最接近运行现场，应先捕获 workflow/job/step 等低层证据；Foundry 再做确定性分类、关联历史知识和人工复核，从而避免中央系统依赖跨仓库日志权限或凭 workflow 名猜测根因。
principles: Capture evidence at the source where repository-scoped credentials already exist.
Transfer structured summaries rather than broad cross-repository credentials.
Central triage remains conservative and can return unknown.
Related-record suggestions are not incident identity claims.
Automatic evidence capture never implies automatic Canonical promotion.
